7.7.4 Freeze Frame Parameters (DM04)
The DM04 message reports the stored FreezeFrame(s).
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00041] ⌈On reception of request for DM04 (call of J1939Dcm_
RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according to table column
“PGN (Hexadecimal)” in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00238]) the J1939 Diagnostic Com-
munication Manager shall use the common “FreezeFrame” sequence with the pa-
rameter FreezeFrameKind set to DEM_J1939DCM_FREEZEFRAME.⌋
The common “FreezeFrame” sequence is described in Chapter 7.6.2.
